  FEUDAL JAPAN STRUCTURES Vol.2
  by PixelKensei Archive  |  https://pixelkensei.itch.io
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

8 top-down pixel art structures & architecture pieces
for RPG, adventure, and dungeon-crawler style games.

Part of the Feudal Japan series:
  Vol.1 — Props & Objects
  Vol.2 — Structures & Architecture  ← YOU ARE HERE
  Vol.3 — Nature & Terrain
  Bundle — Complete Pack        (paid, all 3 vols)

── CONTENTS ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  PNG/
    01_shrine_wall_segment_32x32.png   ← tileable (H)
    02_wooden_gate_mon_32x32.png
    03_stone_well_32x32.png
    04_wooden_bridge_32x32.png         ← tileable (V)
    05_stone_steps_32x32.png
    06_market_stall_roof_32x32.png
    07_temple_pillar_32x32.png
    08_watchtower_base_32x32.png

  spritesheet/
    feudal_japan_structures_spritesheet.png
    feudal_japan_structures_spritesheet_4x.png

  palette/
    feudal_japan_structures_palette.gpl

  source_info/
    HOW_TO_IMPORT_ASEPRITE.txt

── SPECS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Size        : 32 x 32 px per asset
  Perspective : Top-down (bird's eye view)
  Format      : PNG with transparent background (RGBA)
  Palette     : 107 colors
  Spritesheet : 138 x 70 px (4 cols x 2 rows, 2px gap)

  Tileable assets:
    → 01_shrine_wall_segment  tiles horizontally
    → 04_wooden_bridge        tiles vertically

── COMPATIBILITY ─────────────────────────────────────────

  ✓  RPG Maker MZ / MV / XP
  ✓  Godot Engine
  ✓  Unity (2D)
  ✓  GameMaker Studio 2
  ✓  LDtk / Tiled (map editors)
  ✓  Any engine that supports PNG sprites
